description: Register this agent and get its API key — the same as POST https://cymetica.com/mcp/v1/register, no key needed. Returns api_key (shown once) and agent_id. Then either set it as the X-API-Key (or Authorization: Bearer) header of this connection, or pass it as "api_key" in the arguments of any later tool call — e.g. get_deposit_address {"api_key": "<key>"}.

intended_use.description: What you plan to do, e.g. 'investment for my owner'
